_about: The fix queue: art that was already placed in the world when the placement gate was seeded on 25 Oct 2026 (commit 14944c89), and only that. A new asset is never added here: it must pass independent review (scripts/review/gate.py, docs/review-agents.md). A queued asset may stay placed while it is redrawn, re-recorded and reviewed, and only while its entry holds: sha256 is the picture's current bytes (a queued picture that changes is refused until it is reviewed), the entry names when it was queued, why, what clears it and review_by, the date after which it is refused, and an asset an auditor failed carries the auditor's fix_list. Remove an entry when its asset passes (the gate prints an ADVISORY). 26 Oct: the scale gate added assets out of range (docs/reviews/2026-10-26-scale.md). 9 Nov (Claude A, the #439 triage): 48 Crossroads assets placed before the seed and never reviewed, which #421 or the front-gable roof build redraws, and 23 Crossroads props placed before the seed that failed the 8 Nov detail audit, each with its fix list; crossroads/ground renewed at its current bytes; woodland/ground removed (it passes). 9 Nov, after the woodland audit (#444, Claude A): the 13 woodland assets placed before the seed that failed it, each with its fix codes and fix_list (review_by 2026-11-30). The placed-before-seed rule stands. One dated exception, approved by Claude A on 2026-11-09 (the #439 triage): woodland/bramble_b, bush_b, bush_c, holly_b, lintel, standing_stone_broken, standing_stone_lean, standing_stone_runes, stone_top, hatch_closed and hatch_open (failed the 9 Nov audit, with their W- fix codes) and crossroads/square_puddles (cleared by #421's redraw), all review_by 2026-11-30: each was already on main and in its scene, and #439 is the first gate that would refuse it, so queuing it lets no new art in. Each such entry carries an "exception" field. Any further exception needs Matt or Claude A, by name, in the entry. 9 Nov, after the round-2 audit of #447 (docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 2; Claude A): the 17 Crossroads assets that passed are removed; the 14 that failed (13 props and crossroads/ground) are re-queued at their #447 bytes with the auditor's XR2 fix lists, each keeping its review_by. 9 Nov, after the round-3 audit of #450 (docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 3; Claude A): hay_19, hay_20 and waystone passed and are removed; the 11 that failed (seven flower tubs, both lanterns, the stall and crossroads/ground) are re-queued at their #450 bytes with the auditor's XR3 fix lists (ground keeps XR2-G1 and XR2-G2 and adds XR3-G1), each keeping its review_by. 9 Nov, after the round-4 audit of #453 (docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 4; Claude A): the seven flower tubs and both lanterns passed and are removed, the stall failed and is re-queued at its #453 bytes with the auditor's XR4 fix list (review_by unchanged), and crossroads/ground now clears on XR2-G1 and XR2-G2 alone, with XR3-G1 a non-blocking follow-up.

queue.reason: regenerated in #450 under the redrawn props (the 362 ground-edit texels at prop feet, the bakery lip and 912,468; that delta is correct and the 177 distant lawn-scatter texels were ruled acceptable); the 2026-11-09 round-3 independent detail audit (docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 3) keeps it failed on XR2-G1 and XR2-G2 (#421) and adds XR3-G1: re-queued at the #450 bytes with the auditor's fix list (Claude A, 9 Nov); earlier: its contact and cast shadows redrawn in #447 under the redrawn props (that delta passes); failed the 2026-11-09 round-2 independent detail audit (docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 2): re-queued at the #447 bytes with the auditor's XR2 fix list (Claude A, 9 Nov); earlier: queued at the 25 Oct seed (logic.scale; the #288 second review's S5 and S6); its picture has since been redrawn (#436), so the entry is renewed at today's bytes; #421 redraws it again. re-queued after the #288 second review: S5 (ruts, dark discs, even stipple) and S6 (straight seam on the SW road) go to the next fix-queue PR
queue.clears_when: reviewer pass on XR2-G1..G2 (the #421 house and burnt-lot redraw); XR3-G1 is a non-blocking follow-up
fix_list: XR2-G1 (open, #421): burnt lots: replace the even stipple of dark discs with soil marks in drifts (softedge.soil_marks), char as clusters with lit edges, the fallen beams with a lit top edge and grain; fray the scorch fringe in 2-3 px clusters (the #288 S5)
XR2-G2 (open, #421): the #421 redraw needs a full scene-gate pass (24 cells) before it may be placed

XR3-G1 (follow-up, not blocking): make the lawn scatter local, so a prop edit cannot move distant ground: draw it per cell from a seed of the cell, or extend the twice-drawn lawn (kept new only round changed objects) from buildings to every static prop
